daily_report_items: Published the 2,880-word daily research podcast covering NVIDIA, Tencent, Prosus, and Uber; the single audited ephemeral draft render succeeded.

evidence.claim: The controller-validated frozen podcast context version three bound the exact transcript and report paths, the prior successful episode, the exclusive and inclusive research cutoffs, and four successful research developments.

Accepted NVIDIA strategy research supported a bounded full-baseline long-equity candidate from strong operating evidence and favorable scenario economics, while medium confidence, customer concentration, commitments, guarantees, export exposure, and insufficient diversification prevented conviction sizing.

Accepted Tencent strategy research supported a bounded starter allocation from games, advertising, Weixin, fintech, and cloud economics at a refreshed valuation, while China policy, governance, cash-conversion, investment-portfolio, artificial-intelligence-spending, and ADR risks constrained confidence.

Accepted Prosus strategy research supported a bounded increase from discounted look-through NAV and repurchase accretion, while Tencent concentration, private marks, central debt, governance, capital-allocation transmission, and weak momentum constrained confidence.

Accepted Uber strategy research supported a bounded full-baseline long-equity candidate from marketplace growth, cash conversion, and refreshed scenario economics, while autonomy disintermediation, insurance, regulation, incentives, dilution, and insufficient diversification prevented conviction sizing.
Deterministic script validation passed with 2,880 spoken words and five render chunks for the exact frozen page path.
The one permitted audited draft-render invocation succeeded and produced a 1,254-second ephemeral draft outside the repository.

summary: Created a 2,880-word standalone episode in three chapters covering NVIDIA's opportunity-versus-concentration tradeoff, the direct Tencent versus indirect Prosus digital-attention exposure, and Uber's autonomy bargain. All four successful research developments in the frozen window were selected exactly once; none was excluded, and novelty review found no substantial duplication of the prior episode. The episode explains the current Buy / Initiate ratings for NVIDIA, Tencent, Prosus, and Uber, why each position remains bounded, and the evidence-based conditions for retaining the Buy or changing to Sell. The exact transcript link was added only to the frozen report. Deterministic preflight passed, and the single audited draft render succeeded with a 1,254-second ephemeral audio draft.
